recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future JSON Schema defects should be investigated in the current Kindling/publisher generator and generated artifact pipeline rather than by adding redundant core prose or editing generated-looking schema artifacts.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU2 change request reporting invalid generated JSON Schemas: wrong boolean typing, missing base resources, extension naming problems, missing # fragments for external references, blank inheritance references, dotted element names, ResourceList/ResourceContainer inconsistency, untyped extension arrays, and missing code binding support.
initial_application: Commit 2f573be67f84dc9fc721df2d62cd5b2e956c74ff explicitly references old tracker item 12232 and changed the old in-repository JSON Schema generator for base resources, dotted names, ResourceContainer-style references, and ResourceList.schema.json. Later January 2018 commits 4757010487355c7ad9910dc788395f5a1d37d167 and 05bfe5879059bdbd9f7dee5594f67ec819c8c85e repaired ResourceList generation, resourceType discriminator behavior, schema publication wiring, and downloads text, matching Jira's comment that the issue was fully resolved during the 2018 January WGM.
additional_context: The old Java SchemaGenerator was removed from the core checkout in 2021 when the build switched to the Gradle Kindling dependency. Current build-scoped source still exposes fhir.schema.json.zip through downloads.html and validation.html. Current build.fhir.org schema checks found one draft-06 schema with 704 definitions, internal ResourceList refs, no Resource/DomainResource abstract branches, one Parameters branch, resourceType consts, underscore primitive extension siblings, typed extension arrays, dot-free choice names, and a representative code enum. Related JSON Schema issues FHIR-13218, FHIR-14210, and FHIR-17696 are already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current FHIR core source and generated artifact are already correct for the checked FHIR-12232 defects, and there is no current checked-in schema JSON or old generator source in this checkout that should be edited.
